Major Private Hospital Operator Faces Financial Collapse and Break-up

A major private hospital operator is set to be divided following its financial collapse. Lenders have backed a consortium bid to break up the company. The specific details of the consortium or the exact financial figures were not provided in the coverage. This development signifies a significant restructuring for the operator.
